description: Spec 01 arm A, Swin-T U-Net baseline, no NSL; pooled dice 0.9378, FGSM-2/255 dice 0.800
Spec 01 arm B, NSL adversarial alpha=0.2 eps=2/255; clean dice -0.34 pts vs A on all 5 folds, FGSM-2/255 dice 0.918 (A: 0.800)
Spec 02 arm A-prime, rerun of spec 01 baseline; TTA dice 0.9155; fold 1 stopped at epoch 18 (best 8), -1.15 pts vs spec 01 arm A
Spec 02 arm C, full-res conv skip; +0.53 pts vs A-prime, 4/5 folds; TTA dice 0.9211; small fluorescence 0.9138 -> 0.9214
Spec 02 arm D, 2x input scale; +0.47 pts vs A-prime (just under the 0.5 bar), 4/5 folds; TTA dice 0.9197; 2.85x the time of C

Spec 04 arm F, arm C plus strong augmentation (elastic, hue/saturation, gamma, blur, noise); +0.16 pts vs C, 3/5 folds, fails win rule; TTA dice 0.9227 (best so far); H&E unchanged 0.889; FGSM dice 0.833
Spec 03 arm E, arm C plus NSL alpha=0.2 eps=1/255; +0.01 pts vs C, 3/5 folds, no win; TTA dice 0.9212; FGSM-2/255 dice 0.905 (C: 0.818); 2.3x the time of C

Spec 05 arm G, arm C at 2x input scale, batch 16; +0.00 pts vs C, 4/5 folds, fails win rule; fold 0 stopped at epoch 13 (best 3, -1.33 pts), other folds +0.33 on average; TTA dice 0.9206; brightfield 0.908, H&E 0.892; 3.4x the time of C

Spec 06 arm C*, arm C with no early stop before epoch 30; +0.10 pts vs C, 3/5 folds, no win but not below C, so C* is the baseline from here; folds ran 43 to 60 epochs; fold 1 +0.50 (60 epochs, was 27); H&E 0.895 (C 0.889), brightfield 0.908 (C 0.893); TTA dice 0.9219; FGSM dice 0.812; 1.3x the time of C

Spec 06 arm F*, arm F with no early stop before epoch 30; -0.05 pts vs C*, 1/5 folds, no win; -0.11 vs F; with training length fixed the strong augmentation adds nothing; TTA dice 0.9214; FGSM dice 0.832

Spec 07 arm H2, C* and F* predictions averaged, no training; +0.10 pts vs C*, 4/5 folds, fails win rule; TTA dice 0.9223; members alone match their runs (C* 0.9207, F* 0.9202); 83% of wrong pixels lie within 2 px of a nucleus boundary, dice with that band ignored 0.975

Spec 07 arm H4, C*, F*, C and F predictions averaged, no training; +0.23 pts vs C*, 5/5 folds, under the 0.5 bar so no win; TTA dice 0.9235 (best so far); small fluorescence 0.921 -> 0.924; median per-image dice 0.938, 47 images below 0.85 cost 1.46 pts; image 7b38c917 has a near-empty mask, and its two look-alikes in fold 4 score 0.01 and 0.36

Spec 08 arm I, C* plus 5x BCE weight within 2 px of a mask boundary; +0.06 pts vs C*, 4/5 folds, fails win rule; TTA dice 0.9229; brightfield 0.908 -> 0.912, other types within 0.1; FGSM dice 0.808; folds ran 43 to 53 epochs

Spec 09 arm J, C* under plain 5-fold CV: no stop set (the validation fold picks the kept epoch) and image 7b38c917 left out of training and scoring; new protocol, so it does not compare with the 13 earlier runs and is the new baseline; TTA dice 0.9275, highest fold 0.9336, both short of the 0.9368 / 0.9281 target by 0.32 and 0.06 points; folds 0 and 4 (the bad-label family) gained 0.84 and 1.73 pts over C*, the other three 0.04 to 0.17; fold std fell from 0.70 to 0.40; every fold peaked at epoch 31 to 37 on a flat plateau; FGSM dice 0.832; 132 min

Spec 10 arm K, arm J scored photo by photo with saved masks, no training, diagnostic; reproduces J (TTA dice 0.9275, highest fold 0.9336); 89% of wrong pixels are outline rings, 4% missed nuclei, 7% invented blobs; in 38 of 46 photos below 0.85 the model draws every nucleus too big (23) or too small (15); with the best grow or shrink of -2 to 2 px per photo (uses the answer, a ceiling) TTA dice is 0.9341 and the highest fold 0.9386; with missed and invented nuclei repaired 0.9376 and 0.9412

Spec 11 arm M, J plus scSE after each of the five decoder blocks; TTA dice 0.9286 ± 0.0037, highest fold 0.9343 (J 0.9275 / 0.9336); +0.11 pts on the mean, ahead of J on all 5 folds by 0.05 to 0.19, inside the 0.35 luck band, fails the win rule and misses the 0.9368 target; H&E (bright-colour/small) 0.8976 vs J 0.8985, no help where it was meant to help; folds peaked at epoch 30 to 36; fold 0 took 72 min against 24 to 28 for the others (cause not checked), 175 min total

Spec 11 arm L, J plus an additive attention gate on each of the five skip connections; TTA dice 0.9271 ± 0.0050, highest fold 0.9356 (J 0.9275 / 0.9336); -0.04 pts on the mean, behind J on 4 of 5 folds by 0.08 to 0.12 and ahead on fold 4 by 0.20, fails the win rule and misses the 0.9368 target; H&E 0.8979 vs J 0.8985; fold 4 ran to the 60-epoch cap but its curve is flat from epoch 30; fold 0 took 76 min again (as in arm M), 204 min total

Spec 11 arm N, J with the Swin V2 encoder (swinv2_tiny_window8_256, cosine attention, pretrained at 256 px window 8); TTA dice 0.9271 ± 0.0046, highest fold 0.9350 (J 0.9275 / 0.9336); -0.04 pts on the mean, ahead on folds 3 and 4, behind on 1, 2 and 5, fails the win rule and misses the 0.9368 target; H&E 0.8964 vs J 0.8985, bright-gray/large 0.9166 vs 0.9125; folds peaked later than J, at epoch 39 to 56; fold 0 took 83 min against 35 to 43; FGSM dice 0.832; 233 min

Spec 11 arm O, J with the MaxViT encoder (maxvit_rmlp_tiny_rw_256, block plus grid attention and MBConv blocks); TTA dice 0.9260 ± 0.0044, highest fold 0.9337 (J 0.9275 / 0.9336); -0.15 pts on the mean, behind J on 4 of 5 folds, fails the win rule and misses the 0.9368 target; H&E 0.8954 vs J 0.8985, bright-gray/large 0.9027 vs 0.9125; FGSM dice 0.852, the most robust of the five (J 0.832); folds peaked at epoch 31 to 52; 9.4 GB, the heaviest arm; 237 min
